description: Takes one person out of a campaign's audience, as Exclude on its roster does: the removal is recorded with the reason so the campaign never drafts them again, and their queued draft is pulled back. Nothing is sent. Undo it with include_campaign_recipients. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: exclude_campaign_recipients
title: Exclude a person from a campaign
